text: To prevent duplicate credits after interrupted requests, the payments service stores a request key and its outcome in the same transaction. Repeated requests with that key return the stored outcome. A changed payload with the same key is rejected.

Changes to the customer eligibility policy require confirmation by the service owner. A recorded suggestion has no effect until confirmed. Older confirmed revisions remain available for audit, but only the latest confirmed revision applies to new requests.

The audit trail records the source revision and content hash for every excerpt used in a recommendation. If an excerpt's file changes, the earlier recommendation needs a new review before execution can start.

Cargo chilled below 5 degrees Celsius travels in insulated crates. The packing team adds two coolant packs if expected transit exceeds 10 hours. Items that tolerate room temperature use plain cartons.

The evening dispatcher hands unassigned shipments to the next shift lead at 19:00. A handoff receipt names the accepting person. A planned shift schedule cannot establish that the receiving person actually accepted custody.

The replacement deadline is 21 days from delivery. This revision replaces the earlier 14-day deadline. A request received on day 18 qualifies when the item is unopened. Opened items require inspection irrespective of age.

The weekly export task is scheduled for Monday at 06:00 UTC. Its schedule file describes when it should run. Completion requires a receipt from the execution service containing the finished timestamp and outcome. This corpus contains no execution receipt.

Database transactions synchronize writers within one process-owned project database. A second application process must acquire the project lease before writing. If the existing owner's liveness cannot be established, surface an unknown state and require reconciliation before resuming writes.
